[Verse 1]
Here our soliders stand from
all around the world.
[A#5]Waiting in a line to
hear the battle cry.
[D5]All are gathered here,
victory is near. The
[A#5]sound will fill the hall, bringing
power to us all.
[D5]We alone are fighting for
metal that is true. We
[A#5]own the right to live the fight, we're
here for all of you. Now
[D5]swear the blood upon your steel
will never dry.
[A#5]Stand and fight together be-
nearth the battle sky.

[Chorus]
[D5]Brothers everywere.
[C5]Raise your hands into the air. We're
[A#5]warriors, [F5]warriors [E5]of the world.
[D5]
Like thunder from the sky.
[C5]Sworn to fight and die. We're
[A#5]warriors, [F5]warriors [E5]of the world.
[D5]

[Verse 2]
Many stand against us, but
they will never win. We
[A#5]said we would return and
here we are again. To
[D5]bring them all destruction,
suffering and pain. We are the
[A#5]hammer of the gods, we are
thunder, wind and rain.
[D5]There they wait in fear with
swords in feeble hands. With
[A#5]dreams to be a king, first
one should be a man. I
[D5]call about and charge them all with a
life that is a lie. And
[A#5]in their final hour they shall con-
fess before they die.

[Chorus]
[D5]Brothers everywere.
[C5]Raise your hands into the air. We're
[A#5]warriors, [F5]warriors [E5]of the world.
[D5]
Like thunder from the sky.
[C5]Sworn to fight and die. We're
[A#5]warriors, [F5]warriors [E5]of the world.
[D5]

[Middle]
[Am]If I should
[E]fall in battle,
[Am]my brothers who
[E]fight by my side.
[Dm]Gather my
[E]horse and weapons,
[Am]tell my family
[E]how I died.
[A#]Untill then
[F]I will be strong,
[Cm]I will fight for
[Gm]all that is real.
[Cm]All who
[Gm]stand in my way will
[C]die by
steel.
